items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: just Sam and I went in there to get some sandwiches for the boys in the band

ctx.x: bring them on in there. The stuff is ready." When they all walked in there and this guy saw it was nothing but coloons, he liked to have fainted. So Sam said, "What's the matter?" He said, "Uh, uh, nothing, nothing." But he wasn't going to throw that 26 -- those 26 plates away, though, you know. So we got to eating like that.

And so when we went into another place and just Sam and I went in there to get some sandwiches for the boys in the band, so Freddie Guy says, "Hell, if they can go in there, I can go in there too." So Freddie Guy walks in there. The guy says, "You have to go in the back." Freddie Guy says, "What do you mean I have to go in the back?" "Just what I said. If you want something to eat, you got to go in the back." He said, "Don't you know what I am?" The guy says, "You still got to go in the back." He says, "Man, I'm…
